content_text: I would suggest asking the editor and see what his reasons were for making the changes. I would guess the scaling was probably from trying to stabilize the footage (which could require some cropping in) or trying to frame it when eyelines could be closer to matching, but these are just my guesses. But definitely ask your editor!
